APPROPRIATION (AMENDMENT) STATUTE No. 11 OF 2017 OF THE SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCIAL COUNCIL

Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 11 of 2017 of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is passed by theSabaragamuwa Provincial Council on 26.09.2017 and assented by the Honourable Governor of the Sabaragamuwa Provinceon 31.10.2017, is hereby published for the information of the public.
P. S. R. M. WIJAYARAJA,Council Secretary,Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.
At the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council,On this 14th day of November, 2017.

A STATUTE TO AMEND THE APPROPRIATION STATUTE No. 02 OF 2006 AS AMENDED BYAPPROPRIATION STATUTE No. 02 OF 2007 AND STATUTE No. 07 OF 2016 OF THESABARAGAMUWA PROVINCIAL COUNCIL OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLICOF SRI LANKA

1. This Statute may be cited as the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 11 of2017, and shall come into operation of the date of receiving the assent of the Governor of the SabaragamuwaProvince.

2. The limits mentioned in the Advance Account namely 8333 in the Second Schedule of the Appropriation AccountNo. 02 of 2006 as amended by Appropriation Statute No. 02 of 2007 and No. 07 of 2016, is hereby amended asper the first schedule hereof.
